g.text: CIVIL (compensation)
Negligence claims (Module 03's
4 elements) — balance of
probabilities; damages paid;
employer often vicariously
liable; records = exhibit A.
Patient/family sues.
CRIMINAL (punishment)
Assault, manslaughter, unlawful
abortion, practising unlicensed,
falsifying records, theft of drugs
— beyond reasonable doubt;
fine/imprisonment; State prosecutes.
Police → AG → court.
1. Statements: facts only (seen/heard/done), times, quotes — write with in-charge/lawyer, keep a copy.
2. Subpoena = MUST attend; refresh from YOUR notes (courts allow); fees per rules.
3. Demeanour: address the bench, truth even when ugly, \"I don't recall\" beats guessing, no jargon.
4. Coroner's inquests: who/when/where/how died — assist, don't defend; lessons recorded openly.
5. Discipline ≠ court: NMC tribunal can strike off even after acquittal (different tests) — and vice versa.

svg.text: THE CONCERN LADDER (Act 720 protects every rung — document each)

g.text: Rung 1 — IN-CHARGE (verbal + written): danger, short-staffing, faulty equipment, bullying.
Rung 2 — MANAGEMENT/CEO (written, copied): no action, repeated harm, cover-up pressure.
Rung 3 — REGULATORS (NMC, HeFRA, DPC, CHRAJ): unlicensed practice, systemic danger, data breach.
Rung 4 — POLICE/DOVVSU (crimes): assault, theft, falsification, abuse — preserve evidence.
Rung 5 — MEDIA (LAST, lawyer first): public danger + all rungs exhausted + public interest —
defamation law punishes false claims; truth + public interest defend. Never leak patient data.
Victimisation for protected disclosures (dismissal, demotion, transfer, threats) is UNLAWFUL
— report retaliation to CHRAJ/NMC; union + legal aid support. Anonymous where policy allows,
but signed disclosures carry weight. Colleague impaired? Support + report (patients first,
Module 03 duty) — covering addiction/diversion makes you party to the next harm.
Social media: no patient images/details, no workplace defamation, no \"day in my ward\"
identifiers — one viral post can end a career faster than any tribunal.
